name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A billing-details form where a Fieldset.Root with a styled Fieldset.Legend groups two labeled Field text inputs.
stateManaged: none — both Field.Controls are uncontrolled inputs with no value state, no form submission, and no callbacks
nonTrivialInteractions: Rendering Fieldset.Legend inside Fieldset.Root exercises the automatic aria-labelledby linking between the fieldset root and its legend (per behavior.md accessibility section), so the grouped fields are announced with the 'Billing details' legend
